lessons.title: Backtesting Fundamentals
lessons.description: Use historical data to simulate a defined strategy, separate assumptions from results, and understand what a backtest can and cannot establish.

lessons.title: Testable Trading Rules and Hypotheses
lessons.description: Convert a market idea into deterministic entry, exit, sizing, and invalidation rules that produce the same decision from the same data.

lessons.title: Historical Data and Data Quality
lessons.description: Detect missing bars, duplicates, stale values, timestamp errors, and price outliers before they create false signals or distorted returns.

lessons.title: Survivorship, Selection, and Corporate Actions
lessons.description: Build a point-in-time universe, include failed and delisted instruments, and adjust splits and distributions without using information learned later.

lessons.title: Timeframes, Sessions, and Bar Construction
lessons.description: Define how raw trades or quotes become bars, which sessions are eligible, and how timeframe choices change indicators, signals, and fills.

lessons.title: Signal Timing, Look-Ahead Bias, and Data Leakage
lessons.description: Prevent the strategy from using future prices, completed-bar values, revised data, or preprocessing information that was unavailable at decision time.

lessons.title: Trade Execution Simulation
lessons.description: Model market, limit, stop, stop-limit, target, and cancellation behavior using prices that could realistically execute in the tested sequence.

lessons.title: Position Sizing and Portfolio Accounting
lessons.description: Track cash, equity, buying power, open positions, realized and unrealized P/L, rejected orders, and sizing rules throughout the test.

lessons.title: Transaction Costs, Spread, Slippage, and Liquidity
lessons.description: Deduct commissions, fees, bid-ask spread, slippage, and size-dependent market impact from every simulated entry, exit, and rebalance.

lessons.title: Trade Log, Equity Curve, and Drawdown
lessons.description: Create an auditable trade log, reconstruct portfolio equity through time, and measure peak-to-trough loss and recovery duration.

lessons.title: Performance Metrics and Expectancy
lessons.description: Calculate win rate, average win, average loss, expectancy, profit factor, return, volatility, trade frequency, and sample size without relying on one metric.

lessons.title: Benchmarking and Risk-Adjusted Performance
lessons.description: Compare the system with an appropriate benchmark and cash rate, then separate market exposure from independent performance and risk taken.

lessons.title: In-Sample, Validation, and Out-of-Sample Data
lessons.description: Separate rule development, parameter selection, and final evaluation so the last dataset remains unseen until the system is fixed.

lessons.title: Walk-Forward Testing
lessons.description: Repeat chronological training and test windows, choose parameters only from past data, and stitch the unseen test windows into one forward simulation.

lessons.title: Overfitting, Sensitivity, Monte Carlo, and Stress Testing
lessons.description: Test nearby parameters, resample trade sequences, increase costs, remove favorable periods, and verify that the result is not dependent on one precise historical path.

lessons.title: Trading System Specification and Backtest Report
lessons.description: Combine hypothesis, data, rules, execution, sizing, costs, validation, metrics, limits, and acceptance criteria into a versioned system specification and report.
